issue: TotalCharges stored as text; 11 blank values
action: Convert with pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce'); impute 0 inside the Pipeline (SimpleImputer, constant)
justification: Blanks are structurally missing: tenure = 0, so the customer has not yet been billed; 0 is the true value
alternative_rejected: Drop the rows (loses a coherent tenure-0 group, all non-churners); mean/median imputation (assigns ~$1,400 of charges to unbilled customers)
evidence: All 11 blanks have tenure == 0 and Churn == No (data_manifest.json)

issue: SeniorCitizen coded 0/1 while other binaries are Yes/No
action: Keep as integer 0/1 (equivalent to a Yes/No dummy); label as 'Senior citizen' in figures
justification: A 0/1 integer is already the encoding a one-hot binary would produce
alternative_rejected: Recode to Yes/No then one-hot (identical design matrix, extra step)

justification: Distinct customers with identical attributes; removing them would bias the sample towards rarer profiles
evidence: Rows duplicate on all 20 attributes but have unique customerID (data_manifest.json)

issue: 'No internet service' / 'No phone service' levels duplicate InternetService / PhoneService
justification: Collapsing removes perfectly redundant dummies (avoids the dummy-variable trap for the linear model); trees are indifferent
evidence: 5x2 CV, LogReg: collapse_to_No: PR-AUC 0.661 ± 0.018 vs keep_three_levels: PR-AUC 0.661 ± 0.018

action: One-hot (reference-category coding for the linear model; drop='if_binary' for trees); Contract one-hot
justification: Reference coding gives full-rank design and interpretable odds ratios; ordinal Contract assumes a linear effect
evidence: LogReg: one_hot: PR-AUC 0.661 ± 0.018 vs ordinal: PR-AUC 0.661 ± 0.018

alternative_rejected: No scaling / log1p transform of TotalCharges
evidence: LogReg: standardise: PR-AUC 0.661 ± 0.018 vs log1p_standardise: PR-AUC 0.673 ± 0.017

action: Linear model keeps none; tree/MLP models keep none
justification: Only candidates that beat the raw attributes on the same folds are kept (mean gain > 0, corrected t-test p < 0.05; XGBoost tuned for each feature set); count/flag features are exact linear combinations of existing dummies and so are tested for tree models only
alternative_rejected: Keep all candidates regardless of evidence
evidence: PR-AUC gains: LogReg:avg_monthly_spend -0.0015, LogReg:contract_x_internet -0.0001, XGBoost:n_addons -0.0026, XGBoost:any_protection -0.0002, XGBoost:auto_pay -0.0014, XGBoost:avg_monthly_spend -0.0025, XGBoost:price_change -0.0044

justification: Resampling/weighting did not improve PR-AUC beyond fold noise and damages calibration; moving the threshold keeps calibrated probabilities
evidence: LogReg PR-AUC / Brier: none 0.673/0.133, class_weight_balanced 0.672/0.162, smote 0.671/0.160, threshold_moving 0.673/0.133
